title: Working on a Diablo 2 inspired ARPG (DEMO)
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
Hey everyone,

Wanted to post my progress so far on a Diablo 2 inspired ARPG I'm working on!

Trying to capture that dark and gritty feeling I loved so much playing Diablo 2, one of my favourite games. I'm using my own platform that I've built to build the game, happy to share feedback on the process and what I'm using to build

Worked in it for 2 days so far and will continue working on it for the coming days and share progress here

comments.author: florodude
comments.body: I mean i wouldn't name it that...[Path of Exile on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/238960/Path_of_Exile/)

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: It's just a work in progress :) I'll change the name rn to something unique (PoE is obv a favourite game too, got over 2k hours in that game lol.)

comments.author: sooozick
comments.body: Did you vibecode the engine ? Look cool

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: No :), I used some AI as I built it but I'm a dev with 15+ years experience so prefer to build the engine myself - took a few months to get it to this point

comments.author: eXrayAlpha
comments.body: I don't usually get motion sick, but that slight tilt/orbit of the camera when the character moves is giving me the heebie-jeebies.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: yeah it's a bit off still, need to adjust it, especially when the character turns around

replies.author: checkwithanthony
replies.body: Make sure to give an option to disable it or youll alienate the people who cant handle it

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Yeah that’s a good idea, just an added toggle

replies.author: JacobBretwalda
replies.body: Just reduce your camera yaw lag/delay and keep it completely responsive

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: thanks bro! you can actually take the build and remix it here: [https://tesana.ai/play/2244](https://tesana.ai/play/2244)

replies.author: Baphaddon
replies.body: 🫡🫡🫡 thank you for your service

comments.author: tastygnar
comments.body: Damn 2 days?  Thats impressive.  What engine are you using?

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Thanks! I’m using Tesana (www.tesana.ai), the whole thing was built on there

replies.author: tastygnar
replies.body: Neat!  Is it able to create full games or only web games?

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Yep! Full games in the sense they are fully playable etc - but only web based for now, should come a desktop app soon though for heavier builds. This game is web based and worked pretty nice!

replies.author: tastygnar
replies.body: If tou have access to the code, I bet Claude could port it pretty easily

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Yup!

comments.author: DigitalDripz
comments.body:
Hey this looks great ! I have been getting into Unity game Dev using AI to help with the coding :) Can you give me some tips and hurdles you have overcame whilst building this? 

I would love to be a BETA tester hehe

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
Hey thanks! So I was doing unity before but been using Tesana since the launch 2 weeks ago, this whole project was built on Tesana. It’s all natural language based so I’m not writing any code at all - just working in the chat with AI to build out the game. 

Hard part was definately getting the UI just right, but it came out really good! Now I gotta build out the skill tree and abilities and more rooms 

You can also branch out your own build of my game using the remix feature on Tesana - if you press ”Remix” on the link here: https://tesana.ai/play/2244

Good luck!

comments.author: hairybone
comments.body: holy crap how many of these are people making? super motion sick from watching for 5 sec

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Yeah gotta fix that motion sickness 😬

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Thank you!

replies.author: exclaim_bot
replies.body:
>Thank you! 

You're welcome!

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Good bot

comments.author: insats
comments.body: Can we get some sort of self promotion warnings/tags? You’re obviously trying to promote your game engine

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: People are asking me what I used to build it - should I not tell them or…? It’s an ai game dev forum ofcourse people want to know what tools you’re using

replies.author: insats
replies.body:
Sure, but in a lot of the comments you’re acting as if it weren’t your engine. 

I don’t think your post is as bad as many other self promotion posts on this sub, but I do think you posted this largely in order to promote your engine. 

I’m not saying you shouldn’t be allowed to, but a disclaimer is expected IMO.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Alright yeah fair - I mentioned it in the post and replied to the people who asked for it, but this mainly a showcase of the game itself, up to the mods if they want to add that disclaimer

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Thank you!

comments.author: Jindujun
comments.body: I get that you're using Diablo graphics as a placeholder but when you opened the inventory it made me laugh

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Yeah haha, I need to make the design unique later - for now just focusing on getting the mechanics feel right

comments.body: inspired? looks like a straight up copy to me.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Im trying to make it as close as possible to see how I can take with AI - will have to replace the placeholder assets with my own style later once I get the mechanics down

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Thanks!

replies.body: yeah probably :)
